title: Lekki Duplex Living
summary: A calm, layered living space for a young family, built around natural textures and soft daylight.
description: The brief was a family living room that could host guests without feeling formal. We opened up the layout, introduced a low-slung sofa, warm timber and woven accents, and planned lighting in three layers for day, evening and entertaining.
